checks.name: award_recognitions_values_check
checks.expression: btrim("award_recognitions"."organization_slug") <> '' and btrim("award_recognitions"."organization_name") <> '' and btrim("award_recognitions"."category") <> '' and ("award_recognitions"."year" is null or "award_recognitions"."year" between 1900 and 2100) and "award_recognitions"."position" >= 0

checks.name: installment_scores_range_check
checks.expression: ("installment_scores"."story" is null or "installment_scores"."story" between 0 and 10) and ("installment_scores"."characters" is null or "installment_scores"."characters" between 0 and 10) and ("installment_scores"."depth" is null or "installment_scores"."depth" between 0 and 10) and ("installment_scores"."world_building" is null or "installment_scores"."world_building" between 0 and 10) and ("installment_scores"."originality" is null or "installment_scores"."originality" between 0 and 10) and ("installment_scores"."craft" is null or "installment_scores"."craft" between 0 and 10)

checks.name: media_assets_values_check
checks.expression: "media_assets"."byte_size" > 0 and "media_assets"."width" > 0 and "media_assets"."height" > 0 and "media_assets"."focal_x" between 0 and 100 and "media_assets"."focal_y" between 0 and 100
